release_notes: HikMicro HM-TD81C8-150ZK4FL is a thermal & optical bi-spectrum stable positioning (PTZ) camera pairing a 1280x1024 uncooled VOx thermal channel (NETD <= 25 mK, 30-150 mm) with a 4 MP optical channel (4 mm panoramic + PTZ zoom 10-1100 mm), 360 continuous pan, dynamic fire detection and -20 to 150 C temperature measurement.
